verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack only alludes to major versions ("reuse your Svelte 4 knowledge") and to community complaints about breaking changes. It contains no documented versioning scheme, deprecation policy, or deprecation timeline, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
